name: Mukhyamantri Yuba Yogajog Yojana In Tripura
benefit:
1) To provide a grant for the purchase of SmartPhone
• 2) Promoting the youth towards digitalization
• 3) Beneficiaries Undergraduates studying in government colleges or institutes
• 4) Major Benefit Bestowing and amount of ₹5,000 / - (Rupees five thousand) to the undergraduates
• 5) Eligible are Students of under graduate (UG) courses
eligibility_rules: To be eligible for the scheme, the student must follow the following eligibility criteria given below:-1) The student must be a resident of Tripura state.
The student must be studying in a college resided in Tripura state.
A student must be in the final year of the course.
The scheme is not applicable for students who are getting their degree from the colleges which are not in the state.
The student can avail of the benefits once in the lifetime
Applicant must buy a smartphone after the announcement of the scheme in his/ her name.
The scheme does not permit applications from government employees. Students receiving benefits from this scheme are ineligible to receive benefits from any other scheme with the same purpose.
exclusions: The scheme does not permit applications from government employees. Students receiving benefits from this scheme are ineligible to receive benefits from any other scheme with the same purpose.
documents_required: Important documents to apply for the Mukhyamantri Yuba
The steps are as follows: 1) Applicant Voter ID Card
how_to_apply:
Mode: Online For this, visit the official website of the National Scholarship Portal, which is as follows Click Here. The page will look like this.
• Now, tap on the New Registration button provided at the menu bar of the website.
• The new page will appear on your computer screen. The direct link is as follows Click Here.
• Now, read every single detail here. After the read, tick on the checkbox button.
• Tap on the continue button. The registration form will open.
• Fill this form properly. Enter all asked details in the registration form such as applicant name, address, birth date, email ID, scheme type, applicant bank account details, captcha code. After successfully entered all details, tap on the submit button.
• If you are a first-time user, then the OTP will be sent to you on your registered mobile number. Enter OTP, and tap on the submit button.
• Now, log in to your account by entering the Login ID and password.
• After login, choose an appropriate application form and submit your form by entering all required details.
• After that, upload every required document along with the application form.
• In this manner, every citizen will be able to register for the Scholarship Scheme on the National Scholarship Portal Online. Important Points
• Always take a printout of your submitted application form.
• Fill in all details in the application form very properly.
• Always recheck every single detail in the application form before submission
